highlights.description: New Relic integrations for PlexusOne omnisignal and omniobserve abstraction layers
Signal provider for alert and incident ingestion via omnisignal
Observability provider with telemetry export and data query capabilities

added.description: New Relic client wrapper using official newrelic-client-go SDK
omnisignal provider for fetching, acknowledging, and closing incidents
Incident normalization to signal-spec Signal format
omniobserve telemetry export via OTLP-based provider re-export
QueryProvider for reading observability data from New Relic
NRQL query execution with metadata extraction
APM application listing and metrics retrieval
Entity search across all New Relic domains
Convenience methods for querying logs and distributed traces
